basic_details.job_title: UIDAI Assistant Section Officer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has invited applications from eligible officers for one Assistant Section Officer post on deputation (Foreign Service terms) at its Regional Office, Ranchi, in Pay Matrix Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400). The deputation period is five years and the age limit is below 56 years as on the closing date. Officers apply online on the UIDAI Career Portal (https://career.uidai.gov.in), and the complete application, forwarded through proper channel, must reach Director (HR), UIDAI Regional Office, Ranchi by 18.01.2027.

age_limit.details: Below 56 years, as on the closing date for the application. The notice does not list any age relaxation.

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in within the prescribed time limit.
After online submission, download or print the filled application form generated through the portal and sign it.
Give the signed hard copy to your Cadre Controlling Authority or Parent Organisation, as applicable, for forwarding through proper channel.

The Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organisation verifies the particulars against service records and forwards the attested/certified application only for officers whose services can be placed at UIDAI's disposal immediately if selected.

The complete application with all documents is sent to Director (HR), Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Regional Office, 1st Floor, JIADA Central Office Building, Namkum Industrial Area, Near STPI Lowadih, Ranchi - 834 010.
The application must be received complete in all respects by 18.01.2027.

For IAS, IPS and IFS officers, including those in their allotted State cadre, the cadre controlling authority means the Department of Personnel and Training, the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of Environment and Forest respectively. Where no authority is specified for the parent organisation, the authority competent to approve relieving on deputation is treated as the cadre controlling authority.
Duly filled, signed and attested/certified hard copy of the online application.
Cadre clearance from the Cadre Controlling Authority.
Vigilance/disciplinary clearance in respect of the applicant.
Copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or equivalent in the parent organisation.
Certificate from the forwarding authority in the prescribed format at Annex-I.

The Annex-I certificate, on the forwarding organisation's letterhead, states the number of years (not less than three) for which the officer will be relieved if selected. It certifies that the information has been checked against service records, that the officer's integrity is certified, that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated, and that no penalty was imposed in the last 10 years (or encloses the details of penalties). It also confirms that ACR/APAR photocopies for the last five years are enclosed.
important_instructions: Only applications submitted online and subsequently forwarded through proper channel with all required documents will be considered. Mere online submission does not give any right to consideration unless the application is duly forwarded with the documents. Applications received after the last date or incomplete may not be considered. Applications of individuals whose services cannot be spared by the cadre controlling authority may not be forwarded. UIDAI may change the number of vacancies at any time, in its discretion. UIDAI reserves the right to withdraw the circular at any time without assigning any reason. UIDAI reserves the right to post the selected officer at any other location, or to select a candidate for another location, for administrative reasons. For queries, the circular gives Deputy Director, Tel.: 011-23478564, Email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About UIDAI
content_sections.text: UIDAI is established under the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 for developing the policy, procedure and systems for issuing Aadhaar numbers to individuals and performing authentication thereof under the Act. This circular (F. no. HQ-12018/1/2023-HR-HQ) is issued by the Human Resource Division at UIDAI Head Office, New Delhi, for the post at the Regional Office, Ranchi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: This is a deputation post. Private candidates are not eligible. The notice lists the following essential conditions. Central Government officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department. OR Central Government officers with three years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 5 (₹29,200 - ₹92,300). OR Central Government officers with five years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 4 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100). OR Central Government officers with seven years of regular service in Pay Matrix Level 3 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100) of the 7th Central Pay Commission. OR officers from a State Government, UT Government, Public Sector Undertaking or Autonomous Organisation holding a regular post in corresponding grades with requisite experience. Only officers who have completed at least five years of government service may apply. The minimum residual service should be 3 years as on the closing date for the application. Below 56 years, as on the closing date for the application. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Experience of work in Administration, Legal, Establishment, Human Resource, Finance, Accounts, Budgeting, Vigilance, Procurement, Planning and Policy, Project implementation and monitoring, E-Governance etc. Basic skills of working in a computerized office environment. For applicants from an organisation with a different pay structure, the notice treats the following as equivalent grades (along with experience, if any) for non-executive grades in PSUs. If pay is revised in such organisations, the corresponding revised scale applies automatically. Officers holding an analogous post in the parent organisation may be preferred. Applicants may not withdraw their candidature subsequently. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Matrix Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400). The period of deputation is five years. The lending organisation may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its own policy, rules or regulations, subject to a minimum of three years. Recruitment, appointment, salary, allowances, joining time, medical benefits and travelling allowance are as per the Unique Identification Authority of India (Appointment of Officers and Employees) Regulations, 2020 and the Unique Identification Authority of India (Salary, Allowances and other Terms and Conditions of Service of Employees) Regulations, 2020, available on www.uidai.gov.in . Leave is regulated by the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972. Subject to these regulations and rules, deputation terms follow DoPT Office Memorandum no. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II), dated 17.6.2010 and other DoPT orders. If the officer comes from an organisation whose pay structure and/or Dearness Allowance pattern differs from UIDAI, only the pay is protected and not the perquisites. An officer using the Central Government Health Scheme in the parent organisation may continue with it, and is also eligible for medical facilities under the UIDAI Medical Reimbursement Scheme.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Section Officer vacancies has UIDAI announced?
faq.answer: UIDAI has announced 1 Assistant Section Officer vacancy at its Regional Office, Ranchi. The notice adds that UIDAI may change the number at any time, in its discretion.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for UIDAI Assistant Section Officer applications?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of complete applications is 18.01.2027. Applications received after that date, or incomplete, may not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the UIDAI Assistant Section Officer post?
faq.answer: Eligible Central Government officers meeting the pay-level and service criteria, and State/UT Government, PSU or Autonomous Organisation officers holding a regular post in corresponding grade with requisite experience, can apply. Only officers with at least five years of government service may apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 56 years, as on the closing date for the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for this deputation post?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Matrix Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400). Salary and allowances follow the UIDAI regulations of 2020 named in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How do officers apply?
faq.answer: Officers apply online on the UIDAI Career Portal, then give the signed printout to their Cadre Controlling Authority/Parent Organisation. The authority forwards it with the required documents to Director (HR), UIDAI Regional Office, Ranchi.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the deputation?
faq.answer: The deputation period is five years. The lending organisation may relieve an officer for a lesser period, subject to a minimum of three years.

faq.question: Q8. Can private candidates apply?
faq.answer: No. The post is filled on deputation, so private candidates are not eligible.

faq.question: Q9. Can an applicant withdraw the application later?
faq.answer: No. The notice says individuals who apply for the post may not withdraw their candidature subsequently.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must accompany the forwarded application?
faq.answer: The forwarded application must include the signed and attested hard copy of the online application, cadre clearance, vigilance/disciplinary clearance, last five years' ACRs/APARs, and the Annex-I certificate of the forwarding authority.
